site.sitedescription: The mire is situated between steep rock faces c. 150 meters above the valley floor of Boltigen and has a small surface area of 1.25 ha, resulting in a relatively small catchment. Chutti is overgrown by Picea abies and is surrounded by a mixture of forests and grasslands.
